package.description: A fully-modern text-based browser, rendering to TTY and browsers

en-US.description: A fully-modern text-based browser, rendering to TTY and browsers
en-US.longDescription:
Browsh is a purely text-based browser that can run in most TTY terminal environments and in any
browser. The terminal client is currently more advanced than the browser client.
